contract: GET /public/share/:slug/download. Download shared media only with a valid cookie/session and allowDownload; disabled download returns 403 and invalid/expired sessions deny, preserving range/attachment behavior.
exceptions: force is not applicable: no share management or public consumer route has a force, hard or refresh/override mode.

invariants.contract: GET /public/share/:slug/download requires the share_session_id cookie (404 without), an open share, isDownloadable (403 when disabled) and a session bound to that share (404 otherwise). For a folder library item it streams application/zip named '<displayTitle>.zip' via Content-Disposition attachment, with every folder file at the archive root and its exact bytes; for a single-file item it streams that file with its audio MIME and an attachment filename. Deleted or expired shares answer 404 without a body. A missing media file answers 500 and a deleted library item answers 404 from the same session.
